items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I'll call him tomorrow.
items.explanation: Review (Unit 4): er becomes ihn as the object.

items.question: Which one is 4:30?
items.explanation: Review (Unit 3): halb + the next hour: halb fünf = 4:30.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: May I smoke here?
items.explanation: dürfen = to be allowed to: Darf ich ...?

items.question: Which sentence means 'We don't have to work today'?
items.explanation: muss nicht = no need. darf nicht = not allowed. kann nicht = can't.

items.question: Which sentence means 'You mustn't smoke here'? (polite)
items.explanation: 'Mustn't' = darf nicht. 'Müssen nicht' would mean there's no need to smoke.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: The teacher says we're supposed to do the homework.
items.text: Der Lehrer sagt, wir ___ die Hausaufgaben machen.
items.explanation: sollen: someone else wants it. wir sollen.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Shall I open the window? (offering)
Fill in the gap: Could you explain that, please? (very polite)
items.explanation: Könnten Sie ...? = Could you ...?, one step more polite than Können Sie ...?

items.prompt: Could you speak more slowly, please?
items.explanation: Könnten Sie first, sprechen at the end. langsamer = more slowly.
Könnten with ö. wiederholen = to repeat.
Könnten Sie mir helfen? mir = me, the chunk you know from Tut mir leid.

items.instruction: In class, you didn't understand the teacher. Write 3-4 sentences: say sorry, ask them to repeat it more slowly, ask what one word means, and say thank you. Use Könnten Sie ...? at least once. Claude will check it.
items.prompt: In class, you didn't understand something.
